title: Dolphin Swim Enchantment
description: A boots-only enchantment that gives you Dolphin’s Grace in water. Move like a dolphin with increasing speed per level.
body:
**Dolphin Swim** is a boot enchantment that grants you the **Dolphin's Grace** effect when moving through water!

Each level increases your underwater speed, stacking up to level III.

The effect only triggers when you're submerged with air above your head; just like a real dolphin. You'll need to take a breath every now and then.

Custom enchantment applied via loot, trading, enchanting table, or the `/loot give` command:

```/loot give @s loot dolphin_swim_enchantment:1```

Can appear in random structure chests or via villager trades.

Works like a regular enchantment; apply it to boots only.

Automatically grants **Dolphin’s Grace** (and stacks with **Depth Strider**).

Fully multiplayer-compatible: Server-only datapack. Players don't need to install it.
